## 💡 Problem / Opportunity
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
*Example: I'm always frustrated when...*

## ✨ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## 🎨 Mockups / UI Ideas
If applicable, include sketches, wireframes, or screenshots of similar features.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 👥 Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature (e.g. Colleges, NGOs, Election Admins, Voters)?
